question: ________ is an instrument under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF) at which RBI lends to commercial banks.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Repo rate__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Repo Rate is the rate at which the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) lends money to commercial banks in the event of any shortfall of funds.
 
• It is a tool used by the RBI to control inflation and liquidity in the economy.
 
• Commercial banks can borrow money from the RBI by selling their securities with an agreement to repurchase them at a fixed rate.
 
• The Repo Rate is part of the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF) which allows banks to borrow money through repurchase agreements.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 1) Repo rate
 The rate at which the central bank of a country (RBI in India) lends money to commercial banks.
 
 

 2) Reverse repo rate
 The rate at which the RBI borrows money from commercial banks within the country.
 
 

 3) Bank rate
 The rate charged by the central bank for lending funds to commercial banks.
 
 

 4) Cash reserve ratio
 The percentage of a bank's total deposits that must be kept in reserve with the central bank.
